teaser.subline: The furry carnival of Colombia's coffee region, at Hotel Mocawa Resort.

about.title: Why Sunfest?
about.paragraph1: When summer arrives, the Colombian fandom throws a party. Sunfest is the furry carnival of the coffee region: color, comparsa, and community in the heart of Quindío.
about.paragraph2: After Moonfest under the stars, we head up into the Coffee Cultural Landscape to celebrate under the sun, among wax palms, coffee, and the joy of carnival.
about.paragraph3: Sunfest is Furry Colombia's summer convention: an organized space for the fandom, with artistic programming, themed activities, spaces for creators, and stages for the community, without leaving the country.

venue.title: The hotel
venue.name: Hotel Mocawa Resort
venue.description: A resort inspired by coffee culture and Andean scenery, with the vibrant colors of the region's flora. Set in the UNESCO Coffee Cultural Landscape, just minutes from El Edén airport.
venue.description2: Pools with a solarium, spa, gym, tennis court, and Restaurante Color make recovery between events effortless, with plenty of space for the convention and the carnival.
